cases.name: control flow and arithmetic
cases.source: function main(): void { let total: number = 0; for (const value of [1, 2, 3]) { if (value !== 2) total += value; } console.log(total); }

cases.name: closure immediate call
cases.source: function makeAdder(offset: number): (value: number) => number { return (value: number): number => offset + value; } function main(): void { console.log(makeAdder(10)(3)); }

cases.name: object and destructuring
cases.source: type User = { name: string; score: number }; function main(): void { const user: User = { name: 'A', score: 4 }; const { name, score } = user; console.log(name + ':' + score); }

cases.name: generic function
cases.source: function first<T, U>(left: T, right: U): T { return left; } function main(): void { console.log(first<number, string>(42, 'x')); }

cases.name: class inheritance
cases.source: class Base { value: number = 4; } class Child extends Base { double(): number { return this.value * 2; } } function main(): void { console.log(new Child().double()); }

cases.name: rest parameters
cases.source: function sum(...values: number[]): number { return values.reduce((left, right) => left + right, 0); } function main(): void { console.log(sum(1, 2, 3)); }

cases.name: optional chaining
cases.source: type Box = { value: string } | undefined; function read(box: Box): string { return box?.value ?? 'none'; } function main(): void { console.log(read(undefined)); }

cases.name: map and set
cases.source: function main(): void { const map = new Map<string, number>(); map.set('a', 2); const set = new Set<number>([1, 2]); console.log(String(map.get('a')) + ':' + set.has(2)); }

cases.name: async promise all
cases.source: async function main(): Promise<void> { const values: number[] = await Promise.all([Promise.resolve(20), Promise.resolve(22)]); console.log(values[0] + values[1]); }

cases.name: throw and catch
cases.source: function main(): void { try { throw new Error('broken'); } catch (error) { console.log(String(error)); } }
